mediaWork.title: Incendiary: The Willingham Case
mediaWork.summaryNotes: In 1991, Cameron Todd Willingham's three daughters died in a Corsicana, Texas house fire. Tried and convicted for their arson murders, Willingham was executed in 2004 despite overwhelming evidence of his innocence.
